verdict.rationale: Kick documents a first-party MCP server that can query transactions, generate reports, create rules, and execute bookkeeping changes, with custom AI tools getting 'full access to read and update your Kick data'. The CLI is scoped to lookups and reports, and probes for a public OpenAPI/REST spec all returned 404, so nothing shows the programmatic surface matches the full UI. Missing for 10: a documented UI-parity claim or tool inventory covering reconciliation, period locks, chart-of-accounts edits, invoicing/bill pay, multi-entity splits and tax-package export; a public REST API/OpenAPI spec; a CLI with write capability; independent hands-on corroboration.
